subject: Final-mile stall: updated MAP, risk log, and rebaseline proposal
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final-mile stall: updated MAP, risk log, and rebaseline proposal

Maria —

Thanks for the sync today. Per our conversation I wanted to put the current status in writing and share a concrete proposal so we can avoid last-minute slippage:

Summary:
- Key blocker: procurement confirmation for GPU nodes (PO routing) — estimated impact: 10 business days
- Secondary risk: final POC validation step where your SRE found an incompatibility with the 512-token KV cache config

What we propose now (attached MAP-v4.xlsx and a short risk log):
1) Two-week rebaseline window (target close moves from 09/03 to 09/17) — this buys time for procurement and the SRE validation.
2) Canary plan: hold a reserved capacity slot for a one-hour POC during the week of 09/06; Redwood will guarantee throughput for that window.
3) Mutual actions: procurement to confirm PO by 08/31; ACME SRE to validate KV cache patch by 09/02; Redwood to provide patch and a runbook by 08/27.
4) Contingency: if PO is delayed beyond 09/02 we will escalate to a short-term dedicated burst (subject to approval) and propose a one-time credit if the close slips > 3 weeks.

Request: please review the attached MAP-v4.xlsx and confirm the procurement ETA so we can lock the canary slot. If you prefer a different rebaseline date, suggest alternatives and we will adjust.

Attachments: MAP-v4.xlsx, risk-log-ACME.pdf

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124


From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile stall: updated MAP, risk log, and rebaseline proposal

Camila —

Appreciate the write-up and the MAP. Quick update from procurement: PO routing is currently waiting on internal budget owner sign-off; we expect a decision by end of day 2026-08-31 but I can't promise earlier. I've attached the procurement note with the approval chain.

On the SRE side, we can run the KV cache validation but need the patch and instructions by Friday (08/28) to hit your proposed dates. If we don't get the patch in time we'll need an additional 3–4 business days.

Given that, I'm OK with the two-week rebaseline to 09/17 if Redwood can hold the canary slot and provide the patch/runbook on Friday. Also, please send any template language you need for procurement so I can push internally.

Thanks,
Maria
Head of Data Platform
Acme Analytics
maria.lopez@acme.com

Attachments: procurement-note-ACME.pdf


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile stall: updated MAP, risk log, and rebaseline proposal

Looping in a quick internal escalation note — we need to be proactive here. Camila, thanks for the plan. Two asks from my side:

1) Contingency lanes (we should be explicit in the MAP):
   - Lane A (ideal): PO by 08/31, patch validated by 09/02, close 09/17.
   - Lane B (partial): PO delayed to 09/07, we enable a paid burst and a dedicated engineer day to finish validation; negotiated credit if close slips beyond 3 weeks.
   - Lane C (worst): PO > 09/14, push to next quarter close and trigger legal/finance review for contract amendment.

2) Prepare a short escalation note for the account exec playbook in case procurement stalls. Include timeline, estimated ARR impact, and recommended credit range. I'll draft the note and attach it to the MAP.

Jonas — can you confirm capacity availability for a one-hour reserved canary on the week of 09/06? Also want to ensure Finance is aware of potential credit exposure.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com


From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile stall: updated MAP, risk log, and rebaseline proposal

Maria —

Thanks for the procurement update and for flagging the SRE timeline. Per Marissa's note, I've attached an updated MAP (MAP-v4.xlsx) with explicit Lane A/B/C language and a short escalation appendix. Quick clarifications:

- We will provide the KV cache patch + runbook by EOD Friday (2026-08-28). If your SREs cannot validate by 09/02 we will onboard a dedicated engineer and prioritize their validation on 09/03–09/04.
- Holding the canary: confirmed; reserved slot on 09/07 14:00–15:00 PT (one hour). We'll send access details once PO is confirmed.
- Procurement template language: see the bottom of the MAP for a one-paragraph acceptance clause that your procurement can paste into the PO.

Quote of your earlier note:
> "If we don't get the patch in time we'll need an additional 3–4 business days."

If that happens we move to Lane B and trigger the paid burst + credit negotiation. Please confirm procurement ETA and whether your budget owner will accept the acceptance clause. Once you confirm I'll update the HubSpot timeline.

Attachments: MAP-v4.xlsx

Regards,
Camila

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: sara.ellis@redwood-legal.com
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile stall: updated MAP, risk log, and rebaseline proposal

Quick internal update — confirmed capacity and next steps:

- Canary slot: reserved 2026-09-07 14:00–15:00 PT (we've set aside a g4dn-equivalent pool for the test).
- Engineering support: one senior infra engineer assigned for the POC window and a backup on-call for the runbook.
- Credit exposure: Finance has pre-approved a discretionary credit up to 10% of the first-year ARR for this deal if close slips > 3 weeks, conditional on documented MAP actions and acceptance criteria being missed. I'll open a finance ticket and attach the escalation note.

Action items I'm taking now:
1) Create capacity reservation and calendar invite to all participants.
2) Add escalation appendix to MAP with the credit threshold and decision triggers.
3) Notify Legal (cc'd) to prepare a short amendment template if Lane C is required.

Camila — please confirm you sent the patch and runbook to Maria's SRE today. Maria — once procurement confirms the PO ETA I will lock the canary invite.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect
